versionPolicy: 1.0.0 is the proposed pinned release identity. Question registry currently lacks per-question runtime versions; publication must create the approved immutable snapshot and compatibility evidence first.
ownerPolicy: Proposed domain assignments require approval against available normative contracts. Exactly one owner per fact. A read projection may join references but never grants cross-domain table writes.
authorityPolicy: Connection mode and authority are separate. Declare authority per leaf data class/scope. The profile label finance is a grouping only; it must resolve to payment/refund/settlement/payout owners, not one universal ERP writer.
predicatePolicy: all/any with eq/neq/in/contains/intersects/exists/nonempty only. always:true removes a predicate. Missing values propagate unknown, including neq. Use scoped question identity and explicit mappings; canonical effect destinations do not authorize arbitrary paths.

dataClasses.meaning: Catalog description/publication facts; pricing and stock authority are declared separately.
Accepted/catalog price facts with explicit currency/unit and policy version.
Physical on-hand, reserved and available inventory in a declared unit/location.
Published schedule and constraints; resource capacity and reservations are linked distinct facts.
Qualified staff/assets/reference records and ownership; clinical/private data excluded.
Owner-confirmed time/capacity reservation with stable allocation identity.
Versioned workflow state and contracted completion, separate from financial outcomes.
Carrier/team/custody milestone and evidence, not inferred from timing.
Legal/display identity, verified contacts and scoped location references.
Document/evidence review result and applicable authority, separate from merchant claims.
Exact approved method/location coverage; no regulated authority implied.
Actual outward payout confirmation and reference; not inferred from ERP invoice.

exampleCompatibility.schemaCompatibility: A linked field-execution child may reuse SERVICE_APPOINTMENT_V1 and AVAIL_RESOURCE_SLOTS_V1 only when its scope, coverage/travel/evidence fields and team occupation are additionally confirmed. A standalone field service uses FIELD_SERVICE_V1 and AVAIL_DISPATCH_ROTA_V1.
exampleCompatibility.specialtyFields: Pet species/size/coat or handling details, when needed, require newly reviewed typed attributes bound once to the registry; this example does not claim those new attributes implemented.
exampleCompatibility.scopePolicy: Service duration belongs to offering; booking lead time/timezone/service area belong to location/capability; location mode and resource-selection preferences are scoped merchant defaults.
exampleCompatibility.statePolicy: Mixed mode enables a home option; only actual customer-location bookings instantiate a child. Existing resources, charges and identities are referenced once.
exampleCompatibility.activation: Draft only; complete reviewed attribute/child-record schemas, approved owner/command contracts, compatibility tests and atomic publication before runtime use.

unimplementedBoundaries: No runtime registry compiler or schema materializer.
No semantic publication validator or provider adapter activated.
No source events claimed to exist merely because their required fact identifiers appear here.
No approved financial pricing, funding or rounding policy invented.
No clinical record or regulated transaction capability introduced.
